title: Molecular mechanism of Yersinia ruckeri Flagellin C (FliC) induced intestinal inflammation in channel catfish (Ictalurus punctatus).
authors: Yang, Yibin; He, Hao; Huang, Yucong; Ai, Xiaohui; Zhu, Xia; Yin, Fei; Xu, Jingen; Chen, Yuhua
journal: Comparative biochemistry and physiology. Part B, Biochemistry & molecular biology
one_liner_zh: 研究耶尔森菌鞭毛蛋白FliC与宿主TLR5结合诱导肠道炎症，涉及蛋白-蛋白分子对接，但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Yersinia ruckeri is known to cause enteric red mouth disease (ERM) in channel catfish (Ictalurus punctatus). This study established a model of Y. ruckeri-induced intestinal inflammation in channel catfish. Subsequently, using quantitative polymerase chain reaction (qPCR), gene cloning, recombinant protein expression, protein molecular docking, and tissue pathology techniques, we investigated the role and molecular mechanism of Flagellin C (FliC) from Y. ruckeri in inducing inflammation. The findings indicated that FliC was the main virulence gene in Y. ruckeri responsible for inducing intestinal inflammation. Specifically, FliC bound to the host Toll-like receptor 5 (tlr5), leading to the upregulation of multiple inflammatory factors such as tumor necrosis factor (tnf)-alpha, interleukin (il)-6, and il-1beta, and the activation of the nuclear factor-kappaB (NF-kappaB) and JAK-STAT signaling pathways, thereby initiating inflammation. The results were validated through experiments conducted both in cellular models and in vivo. In summary, this study identified FliC as a virulence gene in Y. ruckeri infection of channel catfish and elucidated its role in inducing intestinal inflammation.
abstract_zh: Yersinia ruckeri 已知可引起斑点叉尾鮰（Ictalurus punctatus）的肠道红嘴病（ERM）。本研究建立了斑点叉尾鮰中 Y. ruckeri 诱导的肠道炎症模型。随后，利用定量聚合酶链反应（qPCR）、基因克隆、重组蛋白表达、蛋白质分子对接和组织病理学技术，我们研究了 Y. ruckeri 的鞭毛蛋白 C（FliC）在诱导炎症中的作用及分子机制。结果表明，FliC 是 Y. ruckeri 中负责诱导肠道炎症的主要毒力基因。具体而言，FliC 与宿主 Toll 样受体 5（tlr5）结合，导致多种炎症因子如肿瘤坏死因子（tnf）-α、白细胞介素（il）-6 和 il-1β 的上调，并激活核因子-κB（NF-κB）和 JAK-STAT 信号通路，从而启动炎症反应。这些结果通过细胞模型和体内实验得到验证。总之，本研究将 FliC 鉴定为 Y. ruckeri 感染斑点叉尾鮰中的毒力基因，并阐明了其在诱导肠道炎症中的作用。
